name: Arkansas Headwaters (Railroad Bridge)
evidence: Satellite at 38.9227,-106.1697 (0.27 m/px): north spur pads 1407/1408 ~40-45 m from the Arkansas through a pine band with gaps plus gravel bar, no rail between. CPW tags them Riverfront (type-level claim). Tree band is not an open apron and no site photo was seen, so held at not waterfront.

name: Carter Lake - Eagle
evidence: Operator site page (larimercamping.com): E01-E22 'on a hill overlooking the lake', E23-E49 in meadow below dam with no view. Satellite: hill pads in sparse pines, ~18 m above pool, county road and marina lot between, so not lakefront. Near Water=no in the engine agrees. Site photos not seen.

name: Ponderosa
evidence: Drivable site 24 ~40 m from full-pool edge through sage (satellite d2313, DEM 2296 vs pool 2292); rec.gov photo p24 shows water through shrubs. Lake-closest Lower 26-29 and 12-16 lack Driveway Entry, photos show footpaths: walk-to per NPS, not counted. Other drivable site photos show no water.

name: Cow Creek South
evidence: Satellite e2361 (0.27 m/px): flat grass pads 002-003, 011-014 on water side of loop road, ~10-25 m from high-water edge; DEM 2423-2426 vs Green Mountain full pool ~2423, upstream of dam. rec.gov photos 002, 003, 011-015 show water directly past low willow fringe. Inland: 033-044.

name: Aspen Glen
evidence: FS page: north of CO-14 'along Joe Wright Creek', a creek not a river. Satellite: west-loop pads ~20-30 m (an earlier read 30-70 m) from the creek through unbroken forest, canopy hides the bank; no site photos on the FS page. Creekside unconfirmed, so not waterfront.

name: Baby Doe
evidence: rec.gov photos baby_0-5 show Turquoise Lake through trunks from RV sites 004, 006, 008, 010, 011, 013, 014 (bookable 34-45 ft); AWH filtered-view rule. Satellite a2411: pads 40-100 m from high water in dense lodgepole, no open apron, so not lakefront.

name: Aspen Glade
evidence: Satellite z2540c (0.27 m/px) with RIDB coords: site 020 ~21 m, 023 ~27 m, 022 ~30 m, 021 ~35 m from Conejos River; no road between. rec.gov catalog tags 011-017 and 020-032 Proximity to Water: Riverfront. Photos glade_2 show riparian trees past 020-024; water not clearly visible in them.

name: Bear Lake
evidence: Satellite z2568: all spur loops in dense conifer east of lake, nearest ~160 m from lake corner, no sightline. FS page: lake and pier are a short walk outside entrance, day use only; note says no shoreline sites. Pin sat on day-use loop ~270 m from sites; moved to loops. DEM there 2980.
